Mission Local reported that three friends arrived at the GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m. to wait for “The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom,” with folding chairs, snacks and laptops. About 10 more gamers joined the line over the next three hours. The friends were hoping to buy the limited collector’s edition, and the first three in line got the first three slots to purchase one.
